messages.subject: New R books at Tel-Aviv University exact science library
parts:
Shalom,

Please note that Tel-Aviv University exact science library has purchased the
following R books:

1) M. J. Crawley, "The R book", Wiley 2009 (num. copies: 3, location: 519.83
CRA)
2) P. Dalgaard, "Introductory statistics with R", 2nd ed., Springer 2008 (num.
copies: 3, location: 518.45 DAL)
3) A. F. Zuur, "A beginner's guide to R", Springer, 2009 (num. copies: 1,
location: 519.83 ZUU)
4) J. M. Chambers, "Software for data analysis" , Springer, 2008 (num. copies:
1, location:519.1 CHA)

The library also provides access to the electronic copies of the following
books:

1) O. Jones, R. Maillardet, A. Robinson, "Introduction to Scientific Programming
and Simulation Using R", Chapman and Hall/CRC, 2009
(http://www.crcnetbase.com/doi/book/10.1201/9781420068740)
2) J. Adler, "R in a Nutshell: A Desktop Quick Referenc"e, O'Reilly Media, 2009
(http://proquestcombo.safaribooksonline.com/9781449377502)

In order to access the electronic copies, make sure you set your browser:
http://www.tau.ac.il/cc/helpdesk/glisha/main-proxy/other-isp-proxy/other-isp-proxy.html

Kind regards,
Shlomi lifshits
